build_xformers_package: build the xformers Python package with CUDA or ROCm extensions using setuptools and PyTorch C++ extension
build_extensions_cuda: build CUDA C++ extensions for xformers with CUTLASS includes and NVCC flags for the detected CUDA version
build_extensions_rocm: build ROCm HIP extensions for xformers using hipcc with configurable AMD GPU architecture targets
build_abi_independent_wheel: build an ABI-independent wheel for xformers that works across Python versions by tagging the ABI as none
test_get_cuda_version: test the get_cuda_version function that parses nvcc -V output and returns a numeric CUDA version code
